answer_1.quote: LLM-based product recommendation has become an increasingly prevalent component of user-facing systems, with LLMs now integrated into search engines, conversational agents, and e-commerce platforms.
datasets: fictitious coffee machines, cameras and books
answer_1.outputs: product recommendations in natural language in response to user queries such as "I'm looking for {product category}. Can you give me some suggestions?"

answer_2.quote: We use two key metrics: • Recommendation rate (Rate) -how often a product is recommended by the LLM... • Recommendation position (Pos) -the rank or order in which the product appears... We also include standard ranking metrics, such as Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR)...
